text:
maya: starting the router spline swap for v2 model in eu-west1 at 00:30 UTC. change window 00:30-01:30. plan is 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 10m steps. canaries on the dedicated pool. release notes: https://go/release/notes/5555554321
sam: ack. are we pinning session affinity during the swap to prevent mixed sessions?
jordan: yes — session-cookie pinned to v1 for existing sessions. new sessions will be steered to v2 after the 50% checkpoint.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: r-inference@v2.3.0; canary config: 10% on eu-west1-router-spline; instances=6; commit=abc1234. details: https://go/release/5555554321
lee: monitoring groups set up. thresholds: p95 +20% or error rate +0.5% will auto-pause the shift and notify #incidents.
maya: noted. roll-forward criteria: no infra errors and stable p95 for 15m after reaching 50%. rollback criteria documented in release notes.
opsbot: Observability probe: canary initial p95=112ms (baseline 98ms); CPU 58%; error rate 0.12%. KV cache miss rate 4%.
sam: small latency bump expected. keep an eye on KV-cache miss and prefix cache warming.
jordan: KV misses increased to 8% on canary. suggest reducing concurrency and enabling prefix caching on the canary pool.
maya: applying cache tweak to canary. running traffic command next.
maya: run this to do the gradual shift:
```
robinctl traffic shift --router eu-west1 --from v1 --to v2 --steps 5 --interval 600
```
sam: rollback CLI (if needed):
```
robinctl traffic revert --router eu-west1 --to v1 --force
```
lee: ops note: if error spikes >0.5% at any step, we revert and open a P0. post an incident in #incidents if we roll back.
maya: proceeding to 25% in 5m. will confirm updates.
deploy-bot: Traffic shift: 25% -> complete.
opsbot: p95 now 130ms, error rate 0.3%, KV miss 12%. auto-pause not triggered.
jordan: leaning to continue but recommend dropping concurrency 24 -> 16 on the canary pool to smooth latency.
maya: concurrency lowered as requested. monitoring for 10m then will proceed to 50%.
sam: release notes updated with rollback procedure, affinty details, and change window: https://go/release/notes/5555554321
maya: thanks all — will escalate immediately if we see rollback conditions. :thumbsup:
